args.body:
Hi Dora! I visited your personal website (www.dora-website.com) and wanted to share some quick feedback. The site is very minimal — it currently just contains a brief introduction and your email address. You might consider expanding it with more about yourself: a short bio, your interests, projects you've worked on, or a portfolio/blog section. Adding some structure (an About page, Projects page, Contact page) and maybe a profile photo would make it more engaging and informative for visitors. Keep up the good work and happy to see it grow!

Best,
Emma

Hi Eve! I just visited your blog (www.eve-blog.com) and wanted to share some feedback. It's a nice start — I love that you mention hiking as your favorite hobby! That said, the blog feels quite sparse right now. It would be great to see actual blog posts about your hiking experiences: trail recommendations, photos from your hikes, gear reviews, or tips for fellow hikers. Adding more content and perhaps some categories/tags would really help bring the blog to life and attract readers who share your interests.

Looking forward to reading more!
Emma
